title: Modification in Annexure-5 of Khadi Mark Regulations, 2013 _ regarding.
text: No. P-10/8/2016-SFURTI GOVERNMENTOF INDIA MINISTRY OF MICRO, SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISES Udyog Bhawan, New Delhi-110011. Dated the 10th October, 2017 CIRCULAR Subject: Modification in Annexure-5 of Khadi Mark Regulations, 2013 _ regarding. Please find enclosed a draft notification for modification in Annexure-5 of Khadi Mark Regulations, 2013 relating to Affidavit for using Khadi Mark labels and tags on hand-woven, hand spun khadi and khadi products. 2. All institutions dealing with production, sale, trade & marketing of khadi and khadi products are requested to send their comments/views on the matter latest by 24.10.2017 via e-mail at ceocell.kvic@gov.in for consideration of the Ministry~ (~Under Secretary, Govt. of India S: 011-23062573 s: sahu.jk@nic.in Encl: As above. To, 1. All stakeholders relating to production, sale, trade & marketing of khadi and khadi products. 2. NIC for uploading the same on the Ministry's website. 3. CEO, KVIC, Mumbai - with a request to upload the same on website of KVIC. -- 1 of 3 -- ( ,..I 1 " Annexure 5 Affidavit for using Khadi Mark Labels and tags on hand-woven, hand-spun Khadi and khadi products (Affidavit to be affixed on Stamp Paper of the value as per State Stamp Act) Date: To The Chairman Central Khadi Mark Committee Khadi and Village Industries Commission Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Gramodaya, Irla Road, Vile Parle (W) Mumbai-400056. Dear Sir, "IMle hereby confirm/undertake that (Name of the institution) registered under (Name of Act/legislation under which the institution is registered) intends to produce / frade/ sell in (whichever is applicable) Khadi and Khadi products, and we have been certified by the Khadi and Village Industries Commission and possess a valid Khadi Certificate issued by the Commission. or IMle confirm that Our organisation has been duly registered under _ (Name of Act/Legislation under which the organisation is registered) and possesses a valid MoU with KVIC for Trade/Sale/Marketing of Khadi and Khadi products. Our institution / organisation produces / trades / sells (whichever is applicable) khadi and khadi products i.e. hand spun hand woven and of natural fibre as defined in the KVIC Act. Our Institution / organisation intend to trade / sell khadi and khadi products exclusively procured from Certified Khadi Institutions or KVIC. Such khadi institution should have obtained "khadi mark" issued under these regulations. Khadi Mark Regulation 2013 has come into force from a= October 2013. Under the Act, no person or institution shall produce or sell or otherwise trade in Khadi or Khadi products in any form or manner without obtaining a Khadi Mark Certificate. Similarly, no textiles shall be sold or traded as Khadi or Khadi product in any form or manner without it obtaining and bearing a Khadi Mark. -- 2 of 3 -- These Khadi Mark labels and tags will only be used on genuine khadi and khadi products made of cotton, wool, silk or mixture of these khadi vastra i.e. hand-spun and hand woven fabric. IMJe will be solely responsible for the usage of Khadi Mark labels and tags only on genuine Khadi and khadi products as specified under the Regulations. Any violation of the same can draw appropriate legal actions against me/us. IMJe declare that the information given above is true and will be adhered to strictly. IMJe will be solely responsible for any violation of the same that may entail legal action against me/us. {Signature of Chairman / President / Managing Director I CEO I Authorized Signatory (with seal)} l,f¬ ' A~ C Q [F. No. P-10/8/2016-SFURTI] B.H. ANIL KUMAR, Jt. Secy. Note:- The principal regulations were published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, vide number G.S.R. 498 (E), 19th July, 2013 and as amended vide number G.S.R. 18(E) dated 10th January 2017. -- 3 of 3 --
